source.file: Elden Ring Definitive Companion — v1.1.0 — Production Certified.xlsx

coverageNotes: Route Data contains 994 Act I steps. The workbook's completion ledger claims 4,477 certified route steps; the remaining route sections are not present in this export.
Supplemental Content covers 116 whole-game companion actions across 47 chronology areas, including DLC and endings.

Master Collectibles contains 2,105 item records; Permanent Collection contains 1,787 of those with acquisition detail. The workbook's own whole-game denominators total 1,960 persistent items across 13 categories.
Build data is the certified 14-parent library plus 4 historical redirects; 28 Level-150/200 profiles and 108 loadouts.
The workbook does not independently track platform achievement unlocks; ending achievements are tracked as companion execution state.

journeys.name: Journey 1
journeys.purpose: Definitive 100% exploration, first-acquisition, certified Level-150 master, and all-six-endings run.
journeys.routeScope: Full base game → Maliketh → complete Shadow of the Erdtree → return to Ashen Capital/endgame.
journeys.endingTarget: Six Futures in one run: #1 Lord of Frenzied Flame → #2 Age of Fracture → #3 Blessing of Despair → #4 Age of the Duskborn → #5 Age of Order → #6 Age of Stars PERMANENT.
journeys.alternateChoices: Completion-maximizing first branches; Gideon disposes of Seluvis’s Potion, Nepheli remains ruler, Dung Eater completes Fell Curse; DLC first-acquisition branches follow the finalized 22B matrix.
journeys.remembrancePlan: Phase 22D will assign exact remembrance redemptions/duplications. Until then preserve remembrances needed for unresolved rewards and do not disturb already-certified build acquisitions.
journeys.duplicatePlan: Acquire one copy of every non-respawnable item where possible. Defer only genuinely cycle-limited second/third copies and mutually exclusive rewards; exact remembrance duplicate assignments are Phase 22D.
journeys.cleanup: All regional/Wand/inventory audits; pre-transition missables; required farmables; purchases/finite-resource closeout; Point-of-No-Return certification; Six Futures; NG+ Readiness; Backup B.
journeys.entryRequirements: Fresh Journey 1 or current in-progress Journey 1. Do not enter Journey 2 until CERT-J1-NG-002 passes and Backup B is verified.
journeys.notes: Completion over lore-friendly sequencing when lockouts conflict; sensible story/difficulty order otherwise. DLC remains after Maliketh and must finish before Ashen Capital/endgame. Age of Stars is the permanent/lore-preferred ending.

journeys.name: NG+ (Journey 2)
journeys.purpose: Opposing persistent reward branches, second cycle-limited copies, and certified Level-200/copied-branch inventory completion.
journeys.routeScope: Targeted progression only; repeat content solely when required to reach assigned choices, cycle-limited rewards, duplicate armaments/remembrances, or certified branch inventory.
journeys.endingTarget: No ending required — all six endings and all three Steam ending achievements are completed in Journey 1.
journeys.alternateChoices: Take the second branch of two-way choices: early-kill Alexander; Dung Eater Puppet; Jerren; challenge Millicent; Leda-side DLC rewards; Occultation Iris rewards; Priestess concoction; Bayle’s Tyranny; plus assigned story variants.
journeys.remembrancePlan: Phase 22D will assign exact second remembrance rewards and walking-mausoleum/coffin use.
journeys.duplicatePlan: Acquire second copies required for power stance/signature/certified builds and other genuinely cycle-limited collection goals.
journeys.cleanup: Complete every Journey 2 assignment and outstanding persistent reward/copy; certify the cycle before beginning Journey 3.
journeys.entryRequirements: Journey 1 NG+ Readiness Certification PASS + verified Backup B. Create Backup C immediately after entering Journey 2 before irreversible choices.
journeys.notes: Do not repeat endings for completion. Journey 2 exists for mutually exclusive/cycle-limited inventory and already-certified copied Level-200 branches, not to replace Journey 1 achievements.

journeys.name: NG++ (Journey 3)
journeys.purpose: Close the three-journey persistent-collection floor and third-choice/simultaneous-copy requirements.
journeys.routeScope: Fast targeted route to the small set of third branches and cycle-limited items still open after Journey 2.
journeys.endingTarget: No ending required — ending completion is already closed in Journey 1.
journeys.alternateChoices: Resolve third-way branches: Nepheli potion/Puppet state; requested-death Rya variant if not backuped; reacquire Jolán via Grace and leave the single ash unconverted; optional third story variants only when still desired.
journeys.remembrancePlan: Phase 22D will identify any final remembrance gaps that genuinely require Journey 3.
journeys.duplicatePlan: Acquire only third copies or conversion-state duplicates that cannot coexist sooner; Jolán + Jolán and Anna is the explicit current example.
journeys.cleanup: Final persistent collection/choice cleanup and any 22D cycle-limited remembrance closeout.
journeys.entryRequirements: Journey 2 completion audit and verified rollback copy before starting Journey 3.
journeys.notes: Journey 3 is justified by persistent collection conflicts, not by endings. Later phases may reduce or refine its workload but must not invent extra cycles without a real permanent requirement.

journeys.name: Journey 4+ (Optional)
journeys.purpose: Optional story/dialogue/combat variants or future discoveries only.
journeys.routeScope: Targeted optional runs; no baseline Phase 22B collection or achievement requirement.
journeys.endingTarget: No required ending. Age of Stars remains the canonical permanent Journey 1 ending.
journeys.alternateChoices: Use only for optional variants that were not demonstrated by controlled backups, or for a genuinely new permanent/cycle-limited requirement discovered by later audits.
journeys.remembrancePlan: Additional remembrance copies only if Phase 22D proves they are desired beyond the canonical completion plan.
journeys.duplicatePlan: Optional specialized duplicates only; not part of the current three-journey persistent-collection floor.
journeys.cleanup: Only explicitly approved goals still open after Journey 3.
journeys.entryRequirements: Journey 3 completion audit or an approved new requirement.
journeys.notes: Do not schedule Journey 4–6 merely to replay endings. The old no-backup six-ending assumption is retired by the authoritative Six Futures save/reload workflow.

sixFutures.afterCompletion: Restore Backup A; cure flame; create Backup A2

sixFutures.afterCompletion: Do not restore after Age of Stars

decisions.title: Alexander, Warrior Jar
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose whether to kill Alexander before Farum Azula or complete his duel.
decisions.deadline: Killing him before the Farum Azula duel permanently ends his quest.
decisions.outcomes: Kill early for Warrior Jar Shard / complete quest for Shard of Alexander + Alexander's Innards
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — complete Alexander’s quest and final Farum Azula duel.
decisions.journey1Result: Shard of Alexander; Alexander’s Innards; full dialogue and Jar-Bairn continuation.
decisions.futureOutcome: Kill Alexander early for Warrior Jar Shard.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both distinct shard talismans and experience the complete quest once.

decisions.title: Seluvis's Potion — Recipient
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose who receives Seluvis's Potion.
decisions.deadline: Must be resolved before Seluvis dies during Ranni's progression.
decisions.outcomes: Give to Dung Eater / give to Nepheli / give to Gideon for disposal
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — give Seluvis’s Potion to Gideon for disposal.
decisions.journey1Result: Preserves Nepheli’s ruler path and leaves Dung Eater available for the Fell Curse path required by the Journey 1 Six Futures sequence.
decisions.futureOutcome: Journey 2: give the potion to Dung Eater for his Puppet. Journey 3: give it to Nepheli for the third persistent branch/experience.
decisions.completionRequirement: Resolve all three recipient outcomes across the canonical three-journey collection plan.

decisions.title: Nepheli Loux — Ruler or Puppet
decisions.decisionPoint: Resolve Nepheli with the Stormhawk King or administer Seluvis's Potion.
decisions.deadline: Giving the potion permanently ends Nepheli's normal quest.
decisions.outcomes: Stormhawk King and throne-room conclusion / Nepheli Loux Puppet
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — give Nepheli the Stormhawk King and complete her throne-room/ruler conclusion.
decisions.journey1Result: Nepheli end-state dialogue; Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone; Gostoc expanded shop while preserving her non-puppet outcome.
decisions.futureOutcome: Create the Nepheli Loux Puppet on the Journey 3 Seluvis-potion branch.
decisions.completionRequirement: Retain the ruler rewards/experience and obtain the mutually exclusive puppet branch in a later cycle.

decisions.title: Dung Eater — Puppet or Fell Curse
decisions.decisionPoint: Use Seluvis's Potion on the captive Dung Eater or feed Seedbed Curses.
decisions.deadline: The potion path and Mending Rune path are mutually exclusive.
decisions.outcomes: Dung Eater Puppet / Mending Rune of the Fell Curse
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — complete the Seedbed Curse path and obtain the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
decisions.journey1Result: Mending Rune of the Fell Curse and Blessing of Despair eligibility for Six Futures ending #3.
decisions.futureOutcome: Administer Seluvis’s Potion to Dung Eater and obtain the Dung Eater Puppet branch.
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience Blessing of Despair in Journey 1 and retain the mutually exclusive Dung Eater Puppet in Journey 2.

decisions.title: Pidia — Final Puppet Drop
decisions.decisionPoint: Pidia's corpse carries a different puppet depending on Nepheli's potion state.
decisions.deadline: Determined when Seluvis and Pidia die during Ranni's quest progression.
decisions.outcomes: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet / Nepheli Loux Puppet
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — keep Nepheli free so Pidia resolves to the Dolores branch.
decisions.journey1Result: Dolores the Sleeping Arrow Puppet while Nepheli remains available for her ruler conclusion.
decisions.futureOutcome: Use the Journey 3 Nepheli-potion branch to resolve the alternate Pidia/Nepheli Puppet state.
decisions.completionRequirement: Record both branch-specific puppet outcomes across the canonical cycle plan.

decisions.title: Sorceress Sellen and Jerren
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose a gold or red summon sign outside the Grand Library.
decisions.deadline: The summon-sign decision permanently resolves the quest.
decisions.outcomes: Assist Sellen / assist Jerren
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — assist Sellen.
decisions.journey1Result: Glintstone Kris; Shard Spiral access; Eccentric’s Set; Sellen’s full conclusion.
decisions.futureOutcome: Assist Jerren for his alternate dialogue and Ancient Dragon Smithing Stone reward.
decisions.completionRequirement: Complete both mutually exclusive summon-sign outcomes across two cycles.

decisions.title: Millicent — Assist or Challenge
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose the gold or red summon sign after the Elphael ulcerated tree spirit.
decisions.deadline: The summon-sign choice is irreversible for that journey.
decisions.outcomes: Assist Millicent / challenge Millicent
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — assist Millicent.
decisions.journey1Result: Rotten Winged Sword Insignia; Unalloyed Gold Needle; Miquella’s Needle cure path.
decisions.futureOutcome: Challenge Millicent for Millicent’s Prosthesis.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both mutually exclusive talismans and preserve the Journey 1 Frenzied Flame cure requirement.

decisions.title: Boc the Seamster — Rebirth
decisions.decisionPoint: Respond to Boc's wish to be reborn.
decisions.deadline: Giving the Larval Tear leads to his death after rebirth.
decisions.outcomes: Give Larval Tear / use Prattling Pate 'You're beautiful' and affirm him
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — use Prattling Pate “You’re beautiful” and affirm Boc.
decisions.journey1Result: Boc survives as royal seamster with maximum later dialogue.
decisions.futureOutcome: Experience the Larval Tear rebirth outcome only as an optional later/backup story branch.
decisions.completionRequirement: Preserve the compassionate permanent branch; alternate scene is experiential only.

decisions.title: Rya / Zorayas — Final Request
decisions.decisionPoint: Respond after she learns the truth of her birth.
decisions.deadline: Resolved around Rykard's defeat and her final Volcano Manor location.
decisions.outcomes: Kill her / give Tonic of Forgetfulness / spare her without the tonic
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — spare Rya / Zorayas and do not give the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
decisions.journey1Result: Daedicar’s Woe; Zorayas’s Letter; independent departure and fullest first-run conclusion.
decisions.futureOutcome: Journey 2: Tonic of Forgetfulness outcome. Journey 3: requested-death outcome, unless viewed from a controlled backup.
decisions.futureJourney: NG+ — Journey 2; NG++ — Journey 3 or controlled backups
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience all three outcomes while preserving the letter-granting Journey 1 branch.

decisions.title: Brother Corhyn — Tonic of Forgetfulness
decisions.decisionPoint: Offer Corhyn the tonic in the Mountaintops.
decisions.deadline: Must be offered before Maliketh for the alternate final location.
decisions.outcomes: Offer tonic / do not offer tonic
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — do not offer Corhyn the Tonic of Forgetfulness.
decisions.journey1Result: Corhyn’s normal late-game / Ashen Capital dialogue path.
decisions.futureOutcome: Offer the tonic for his alternate Mountaintops conclusion/dialogue.
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience both story outcomes; equipment and bell bearing remain obtainable either way.

decisions.title: Seluvis — Amber Draught for Ranni
decisions.decisionPoint: Attempt to administer Seluvis's Amber Draught to Ranni.
decisions.deadline: Do this only before advancing Ranni beyond the relevant stage; absolution is required to resume safely.
decisions.outcomes: Do not administer / administer and later seek absolution
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — do not administer Seluvis’s Amber Draught to Ranni.
decisions.journey1Result: Ranni’s quest proceeds without hostility or interruption to the permanent Age of Stars conclusion.
decisions.futureOutcome: Experience Ranni’s rejection, Seluvis’s consequence, and absolution recovery only on a later/controlled branch.
decisions.completionRequirement: Protect Journey 1 Ranni progression; alternate interaction is experiential only.

decisions.title: Three Fingers — Inheritance Timing
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose whether to inherit the Frenzied Flame before or after the Forge.
decisions.deadline: Opening the Three Fingers' door before the Forge causes Melina to leave.
decisions.outcomes: Avoid flame / inherit before Forge / inherit after Melina's sacrifice / inherit then cure
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — do not inherit the Frenzied Flame before the Forge. After Melina’s Forge sacrifice, and only once the Miquella’s Needle cure route is secured, inherit the Flame before the final Six Futures ending sequence.
decisions.journey1Result: Preserves Melina’s normal Forge conclusion while enabling Lord of Frenzied Flame as ending #1; Backup A is then restored, the Flame is cured, and Backup A2 supports endings #2–#6.
decisions.futureOutcome: Optional later experience: pre-Forge inheritance branch for the alternate Melina Frenzied Flame scene.
decisions.futureJourney: NG+ — Journey 2 or controlled backup (optional experience)
decisions.completionRequirement: Execute the Journey 1 Backup A → cure → Backup A2 contract without sacrificing the preferred permanent story path.

decisions.title: Age of Fracture
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose to mend the Elden Ring without a Mending Rune.
decisions.deadline: Final interaction after Elden Beast.
decisions.outcomes: Age of Fracture
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #2: Age of Fracture from Backup A2.
decisions.journey1Result: Age of Fracture viewed; Elden Lord Steam achievement satisfied if not already earned.
decisions.futureOutcome: None — ending experience is completed in Journey 1.
decisions.futureJourney: None — no later ending journey required
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience Age of Fracture once, then restore Backup A2.

decisions.title: Age of Order
decisions.decisionPoint: Use the Mending Rune of Perfect Order.
decisions.deadline: Complete Goldmask's quest before the ending choice.
decisions.outcomes: Age of Order
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #5: Age of Order from Backup A2.
decisions.journey1Result: Age of Order viewed.
decisions.futureOutcome: None — ending experience is completed in Journey 1.
decisions.futureJourney: None — no later ending journey required
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience Age of Order once, restore Backup A2, then proceed to Age of Stars.

decisions.title: Age of the Duskborn
decisions.decisionPoint: Use the Mending Rune of the Death-Prince.
decisions.deadline: Complete Fia's quest before the ending choice.
decisions.outcomes: Age of the Duskborn
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #4: Age of the Duskborn from Backup A2.
decisions.journey1Result: Age of the Duskborn viewed.
decisions.futureOutcome: None — ending experience is completed in Journey 1.
decisions.futureJourney: None — no later ending journey required
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience Age of the Duskborn once, then restore Backup A2.

decisions.title: Blessing of Despair
decisions.decisionPoint: Use the Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
decisions.deadline: Requires the Dung Eater curse path instead of his puppet path.
decisions.outcomes: Blessing of Despair
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #3: Blessing of Despair from Backup A2.
decisions.journey1Result: Blessing of Despair viewed using the Journey 1 Mending Rune of the Fell Curse.
decisions.futureOutcome: None for the ending; the mutually exclusive Dung Eater Puppet reward is assigned to Journey 2.
decisions.futureJourney: NG+ — Journey 2 only for Dung Eater Puppet, not for the ending
decisions.completionRequirement: Complete BASE-004 Fell Curse in Journey 1, experience Blessing of Despair, then restore Backup A2.

decisions.title: Age of the Stars
decisions.decisionPoint: Use Ranni's blue summon sign after the final boss.
decisions.deadline: Complete Ranni's quest and avoid retaining the Frenzied Flame.
decisions.outcomes: Age of the Stars
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #6: Age of Stars from Backup A2; PERMANENT Journey 1 conclusion.
decisions.journey1Result: Age of the Stars Steam achievement; permanent postgame world retained for Journey 1 museum/cleanup state.
decisions.futureOutcome: None — do not repeat this ending for completion.
decisions.completionRequirement: Choose Age of Stars last, do not restore Backup A2 afterward, and decline immediate NG+.

decisions.title: Lord of Frenzied Flame
decisions.decisionPoint: Finish while still possessing the Frenzied Flame.
decisions.deadline: Retaining the flame overrides every other ending.
decisions.outcomes: Frenzied Flame with Melina sacrificed / bonus Melina cutscene if she survives
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — Six Futures #1: Lord of Frenzied Flame while Backup A preserves the active-Flame state.
decisions.journey1Result: Lord of Frenzied Flame Steam achievement and ending viewed first.
decisions.futureOutcome: None — ending experience is completed in Journey 1. Optional pre-Forge Melina variant remains a story-experience branch only.
decisions.futureJourney: None for the ending; optional NG+/backup only for alternate Melina scene
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience first, restore Backup A, cure the Frenzied Flame with Miquella’s Needle, then create Backup A2.

decisions.title: Moore — After Miquella's Rune Breaks
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose how Moore should respond to his despair.
decisions.deadline: Choice appears after the great rune breaks; later progression moves or kills him.
decisions.outcomes: Put it behind you / remain sad forever / I don't know
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — tell Moore to “put it behind you.”
decisions.journey1Result: Moore continues to the later follower battle; fullest continuation is retained on the first run.
decisions.futureOutcome: Journey 2: “remain sad forever.” Journey 3: “I don’t know” only if the optional dialogue/state variant is still desired.
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience the major alternate state without creating a fourth mandatory cycle.

decisions.title: Leda and Hornsent — Shadow Keep Signs
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose which summon sign to use near the Storehouse crossroads.
decisions.deadline: The signs disappear after progressing through the Dark Chamber / Messmer sequence.
decisions.outcomes: Help Hornsent / help Leda / ignore
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — help Hornsent against Leda.
decisions.journey1Result: Ash of War: Swift Slash; Hornsent remains available for Messmer and later story.
decisions.futureOutcome: Help Leda against Hornsent for Lacerating Crossed-Tree.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both mutually exclusive persistent rewards across two cycles.

decisions.title: Leda and Ansbach — Shadow Keep Signs
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose to defend Ansbach, invade him with Leda, or ignore the signs.
decisions.deadline: Available only when the Hornsent branch permits it and before Messmer progression closes the signs.
decisions.outcomes: Help Ansbach / help Leda / ignore
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — preserve and help Ansbach.
decisions.journey1Result: Ansbach’s Longbow; Obsidian Lamina; Furious Blade of Ansbach; Ansbach’s Set and finale summons.
decisions.futureOutcome: Invade/oppose Ansbach with Leda for Retaliatory Crossed-Tree.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both opposing persistent reward branches across two cycles.

decisions.title: Messmer — NPC Summon
decisions.decisionPoint: Choose Hornsent, Jolan, or no NPC summon inside Messmer's arena.
decisions.deadline: Only one NPC can be summoned; Hornsent is unavailable if invaded with Leda.
decisions.outcomes: Summon Hornsent / summon Jolan / summon neither
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — summon Hornsent for Messmer and exhaust his post-boss dialogue.
decisions.journey1Result: Hornsent participation and later Rauh route/dialogue.
decisions.futureOutcome: Journey 2: summon Jolán. Journey 3: no-summon variant only if still desired for complete combat/story experience.
decisions.completionRequirement: Experience the meaningful NPC summon variants; no unique permanent reward is tied solely to this choice.

decisions.title: Fire Knight Queelign — Iris
decisions.decisionPoint: Give Queelign an Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation.
decisions.deadline: Irreversible once an iris is given.
decisions.outcomes: Iris of Grace for Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash / Iris of Occultation for Queelign's Greatsword
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — give Fire Knight Queelign an Iris of Grace.
decisions.journey1Result: Fire Knight Queelign Spirit Ash.
decisions.futureOutcome: Give an Iris of Occultation for Queelign’s Greatsword.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both mutually exclusive Queelign rewards across two cycles.

decisions.title: Swordhand of Night Jolán — Iris
decisions.decisionPoint: Give Jolán an Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation.
decisions.deadline: Irreversible once an iris is given.
decisions.outcomes: Iris of Grace for Jolán Spirit Ash / Iris of Occultation for Sword of Night
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — give Jolán an Iris of Grace, then use that ash for the DLC-007 Jolán-and-Anna conversion.
decisions.journey1Result: Swordhand of Night Jolán Spirit Ash acquired, then converted so Jolán and Anna can be retained.
decisions.futureOutcome: Journey 2: Iris of Occultation for Sword of Night. Journey 3: Iris of Grace again to reacquire a single Jolán Spirit Ash and leave it unconverted.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own Sword of Night, Jolán and Anna, and a separate unconverted Jolán Spirit Ash across three cycles.

decisions.title: Jolán and Anna — Spirit Ash Conversion
decisions.decisionPoint: Use Jolán's Spirit Ash at Anna's puppet.
decisions.deadline: Conversion replaces the single Jolán ash with Jolán and Anna.
decisions.outcomes: Keep single Jolán ash / convert to Jolán and Anna
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — convert the first Jolán Spirit Ash into Jolán and Anna.
decisions.journey1Result: Jolán and Anna Spirit Ash retained on the permanent collection.
decisions.futureOutcome: Reacquire Jolán Spirit Ash in Journey 3 and leave that copy unconverted.
decisions.completionRequirement: Retain both Jolán and Anna and a separate single Jolán Spirit Ash in the persistent collection.

decisions.title: Dragon Communion Priestess — Concoction
decisions.decisionPoint: Give Thiollier's Concoction at night before Bayle or leave her undrugged.
decisions.deadline: Must be decided before defeating Bayle.
decisions.outcomes: Concoction: Dragonbolt of Florissax + Ancient Dragon Florissax / no concoction: Flowerstone Gavel + Priestess Heart
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — leave the Dragon Communion Priestess undrugged.
decisions.journey1Result: Flowerstone Gavel + Priestess Heart, preserving the certified first-acquisition recommendation used by the Dragon Communion / lightning build ecosystem.
decisions.futureOutcome: Use Thiollier’s Concoction before Bayle for Dragonbolt of Florissax + Ancient Dragon Florissax.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both mutually exclusive Priestess reward pairs across two cycles.

decisions.title: Heart of Bayle — Communion Reward
decisions.decisionPoint: Exchange Bayle's unique heart at the Grand Altar.
decisions.deadline: The Heart of Bayle cannot be duplicated.
decisions.outcomes: Bayle's Flame Lightning / Bayle's Tyranny
decisions.journey1: Journey 1 — exchange the first Heart of Bayle for Bayle’s Flame Lightning.
decisions.journey1Result: Bayle’s Flame Lightning acquired as the first Heart reward.
decisions.futureOutcome: Exchange Journey 2’s Heart of Bayle for Bayle’s Tyranny.
decisions.completionRequirement: Own both non-duplicable Heart of Bayle incantations across two cycles.

endings.name: Age of Fracture
endings.afterCompletion: Restore Backup A2 after the ending.

endings.name: Blessing of Despair
endings.afterCompletion: Restore Backup A2 after the ending.

endings.name: Age of the Duskborn
endings.afterCompletion: Restore Backup A2 after the ending.

endings.name: Age of Order
endings.afterCompletion: Restore Backup A2 after the ending.

endings.afterCompletion: Permanent Journey 1 conclusion. Choose NO for immediate NG+, complete the final NG+ Readiness Certification, then create Backup B before beginning Journey 2.

certifications.name: Point of No Return
certifications.timing: At Fractured Marika before selecting an ending
certifications.purpose: Certify all six ending prerequisites, audits, free-roam tasks, and future-journey assignments.
certifications.notes: No ending should be selected until this checkpoint is complete.

certifications.name: Backup A — Frenzied Flame Active
certifications.purpose: Preserve the forced Frenzied Flame state before the first ending.
certifications.notes: Verify the copied ER0000.sl2 file before relaunching.

certifications.name: Frenzied Flame Cleansed
certifications.timing: After viewing Lord of Frenzied Flame
certifications.purpose: Restore Backup A and use Miquella's Needle so the remaining endings become available.
certifications.notes: This permanently removes the Frenzied Flame ending from the restored branch.

certifications.name: Backup A2 — Frenzy Cured
certifications.purpose: Create the recovery point for four Elden Lord variants and Age of Stars.
certifications.notes: Restore this same backup after each non-permanent ending.

certifications.name: NG+ Readiness Certification
certifications.timing: During postgame free-roam after Age of Stars
certifications.purpose: Finish purchases, remembrances, finite materials, audits, and Journey 2 assignments.
certifications.notes: This must pass before Backup B is created or Journey 2 begins.

certifications.name: Backup B — Journey 1 Museum Save
certifications.timing: After NG+ Readiness Certification, before Journey 2
certifications.purpose: Preserve the fully prepared Journey 1 world and permanent character state.

transitionGates.trigger: Commit Seluvis’s Potion to a recipient or advance Ranni far enough that Seluvis is no longer available
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before using Seluvis’s Potion and before advancing past its usable quest window
transitionGates.preCheck: Confirm BASE-002 / BASE-003 / BASE-004 / BASE-005. Journey 1 = Gideon disposal + Nepheli ruler + Dung Eater Fell Curse; Journey 2 = Dung Eater Puppet; Journey 3 = Nepheli potion branch.
transitionGates.notes: The four linked decisions are one shared branch family; resolving them independently would create contradictory journey states.

transitionGates.trigger: Kill Alexander before his Farum Azula duel instead of completing the quest
transitionGates.safeWindow: Journey 1: keep Alexander alive through the final duel; Journey 2: take the early-kill branch when assigned
transitionGates.preCheck: Confirm BASE-001 journey assignment before attacking Alexander.
transitionGates.notes: Journey 1 preserves the complete dialogue/quest branch; the mutually exclusive early reward is intentionally deferred.

transitionGates.trigger: Choose Sellen’s or Jerren’s summon sign
transitionGates.safeWindow: At the two summon signs after the required Sellen/Jerren setup
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 = assist Sellen. Journey 2 = assist Jerren. Confirm BASE-006 before touching either sign.
transitionGates.notes: Choice ownership is fixed by Phase 22B; Phase 22C only enforces the deadline.

transitionGates.trigger: Choose Assist Millicent or Challenge Millicent after the ulcerated tree spirit
transitionGates.safeWindow: Journey 1: before touching either summon sign, with the cure-route requirement still open
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 must assist Millicent and preserve the Unalloyed Gold Needle → Miquella’s Needle route. Journey 2 may challenge for Millicent’s Prosthesis.
transitionGates.notes: This is elevated to Critical because the Journey 1 ending workflow depends on retaining a valid Frenzied Flame cure route.

transitionGates.trigger: Defeat Rykard before the Manor/Rya/pre-Rykard completion package is closed
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before entering Rykard’s final boss completion state
transitionGates.preCheck: Complete all desired Manor contracts and NPC states; finish SUP-J1-VM-001 while Rykard is alive; confirm BASE-009 Journey 1 spare/no-tonic branch.
transitionGates.notes: Supersedes the old Draft/Future global warning with an executable Companion-owned pre-Rykard gate while preserving the legacy record.

transitionGates.trigger: Resolve Rya’s final request with kill, tonic, or spare/no-tonic branch
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before closing Rya’s final Volcano Manor state around the Rykard sequence
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 = spare/no tonic; Journey 2 = tonic; Journey 3 or controlled backup = requested-death outcome. Confirm BASE-009.
transitionGates.notes: Tracked separately from the Rykard gate because the three Rya outcomes are themselves a canonical multi-journey requirement.

transitionGates.trigger: Inherit the Frenzied Flame before Melina completes the approved Forge role
transitionGates.area: Forge of the Giants / Three Fingers
transitionGates.safeWindow: Journey 1: do not inherit before the Forge; inherit only after Melina’s sacrifice and only after the cure route is secured
transitionGates.preCheck: Confirm BASE-012 and BASE-007. The approved order is Forge first → secure Backup A → inherit flame for Ending #1 → restore Backup A → cure → Backup A2.
transitionGates.notes: The optional pre-Forge Melina variant belongs to a later controlled branch, not the canonical Journey 1 permanent state.

transitionGates.trigger: Defeat Maliketh before the Royal Capital and pre-transition completion certification is closed
transitionGates.safeWindow: At Beside the Great Bridge before crossing Maliketh’s fog gate
transitionGates.preCheck: Complete the Companion’s pre-Maliketh certification/action package, all required Royal Capital cleanup, choice deadlines due before Maliketh, and every other explicitly open pre-transition blocker.
transitionGates.notes: This converts the old Draft/Future Maliketh warning into a mandatory executable point-of-no-return firewall.

transitionGates.trigger: Allow Miquella’s Great Rune break to occur without closing the pre-break NPC interaction state required by the active guide/choice plan
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before the configured Great Rune break transition is allowed to occur
transitionGates.preCheck: Follow the assigned DLC guide through every pre-break NPC conversation and confirm DLC-001 plus any still-open first-state dialogue obligations.
transitionGates.notes: Phase 22C owns the transition deadline; detailed spatial walkthrough remains delegated to the assigned DLC guide.

transitionGates.trigger: Advance through the Messmer cutoff before resolving the Leda–Hornsent and Leda–Ansbach summon-sign branches assigned to the journey
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before Messmer progression closes the relevant Shadow Keep summon signs
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 = help Hornsent and preserve/defend Ansbach. Journey 2 = Leda-side opposing branches. Confirm DLC-002 and DLC-003 before progressing.
transitionGates.notes: The exact combat path remains in the DLC guide; the Companion owns the must-resolve-before-Messmer completion contract.

transitionGates.trigger: Give an Iris to Queelign or Jolán without following the journey allocation
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before handing either NPC an Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 = Grace for Queelign and Jolán; Journey 2 = Occultation for both. Confirm DLC-005 and DLC-006.
transitionGates.notes: Two separate choices share one finite-item family and should be checked together before either iris is consumed.

transitionGates.trigger: Convert Swordhand of Night Jolán Spirit Ash into Jolán and Anna without preserving the later single-Jolán requirement
transitionGates.safeWindow: Journey 1: convert after recording/acquiring Jolán; Journey 3: reacquire Jolán via Grace and leave that copy unconverted
transitionGates.preCheck: Confirm DLC-007 and the three-journey persistent-collection plan.
transitionGates.notes: The conversion is intentional in Journey 1, but the firewall prevents incorrectly treating the single ash as permanently complete afterward.

transitionGates.trigger: Defeat Bayle before the Dragon Communion Priestess branch is set for the journey
transitionGates.area: Jagged Peak / Grand Altar of Dragon Communion
transitionGates.preCheck: Journey 1 = leave Priestess undrugged for Flowerstone Gavel + Priestess Heart. Journey 2 = Thiollier’s Concoction route for Dragonbolt of Florissax + Ancient Dragon Florissax. Confirm DLC-008.
transitionGates.notes: Heart of Bayle reward allocation remains tracked by DLC-009 and will be further integrated with remembrance/cycle planning where appropriate.

transitionGates.trigger: Cross the sealing-tree / late-DLC irreversible handoff before the active DLC NPC and branch cleanup is complete
transitionGates.area: Ancient Ruins of Rauh / sealing-tree transition
transitionGates.safeWindow: Immediately before the sealing-tree cutoff identified by the assigned DLC guide
transitionGates.preCheck: Complete Rauh NPC/quest cleanup, resolve all still-open DLC choice dependencies, and pass the Companion’s final pre-Enir-Ilim handoff action before committing.
transitionGates.notes: This is a completion firewall, not a replacement walkthrough; Roundtable/Wand remain responsible for spatial cleanup and route details.

transitionGates.trigger: Start the Six Futures ending sequence without the required backup and Frenzied Flame cure state
transitionGates.safeWindow: Before Ending #1 and again before the Elden Lord variant sequence
transitionGates.preCheck: Require the Endings & Achievements point-of-no-return certification, Backup A, valid Miquella’s Needle cure route, then Backup A2 after cure. Preserve exact #1–#6 order and Age of Stars PERMANENT.
transitionGates.notes: Phase 22C does not alter Six Futures; it makes the prerequisite state an explicit lockout gate.

transitionGates.trigger: Begin Journey 2 before the Journey 1 museum-save and completion certifications are closed
transitionGates.safeWindow: Postgame free-roam before selecting Begin Journey 2
transitionGates.preCheck: Pass CERT-J1-NG-002 and the full NG+ readiness sequence, resolve every required Journey 1 blocker, create/verify Backup B, then begin Journey 2 and create Backup C.
transitionGates.notes: This is the final Journey 1 completion firewall. Phase 22D–22I may add additional required checks to the same certification without changing the transition semantics.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Eventually purchase every finite / one-stock item represented by the existing 167-row Merchants registry. Infinite ammunition/material stock is availability-only, not a requirement to buy arbitrary quantities.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before Journey 1 NG+ Readiness; earlier whenever linked quest progression can remove direct shop access.
merchantCloseout.notes: Purchase eventually; not necessarily on first encounter. Preserve player Purchased Status / Purchased At in the source sheet.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Turn in acquired merchant/instructor bell bearings and clear finite stock carried through them before NG+ certification.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Final Journey 1 merchant closeout; repeat for later-cycle branch-only bearings.
merchantCloseout.coverage: Existing Twin Maiden rows + all acquired bearings
merchantCloseout.notes: Bell bearings are continuity, not permission to kill merchants early. Preserve quest outcomes first.

merchantCloseout.merchant: Merchant Kalé + Nomadic / Isolated / Hermit merchant family
merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear all finite and one-stock inventory from every encountered wandering merchant; do not bulk-buy infinite arrows/bolts/materials.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before NG+; no early-kill requirement.
merchantCloseout.coverage: Legacy family represented + delegated later locations
merchantCloseout.notes: Buy finite stock eventually and use the external inventory audit to prove no merchant location was omitted.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Preserve the canonical quest branch and clear all finite stock exposed by his shop states or later bell-bearing continuity.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before any linked Patches/Rya/Volcano Manor state removes direct access; definitely before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Quest completion takes priority over immediate shopping; purchase can be deferred until the last safe shop state.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Keep Gostoc alive through the Journey 1 Nepheli/Kenneth ruler conclusion and purchase the finite expanded stock that becomes available.
merchantCloseout.deadline: After ruler-state expansion and before NG+; later-cycle branches follow their assigned journey contract.
merchantCloseout.notes: Preserve the quest-linked shop expansion before closeout.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear all finite Ash-of-War / shop inventory while preserving the Volcano Manor and Farum Azula quest path.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before his quest endpoint or through valid bell-bearing continuity; before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not kill Bernahl for shop convenience.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear all finite incantation inventory exposed by the canonical Corhyn/Goldmask progression or later bell-bearing continuity.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before closing the Journey 1 Corhyn/Goldmask state; before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Quest dialogue/end-state first; inventory closeout by final safe access or bearing.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear all finite sorcery inventory and accepted scroll expansions while preserving the Journey 1 Sellen branch.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before resolving BASE-006; later-cycle Jerren branch uses bearing/recovery as applicable.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not sacrifice the canonical branch merely to simplify shop access.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear represented finite inventory before his quest state removes direct interaction, or through legitimate bearing continuity.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before his terminal Roundtable state; before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Purchase eventually; preserve quest dialogue first.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear represented finite inventory while preserving the Fia/D questline; use legitimate bearing continuity after quest progression.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before final Fia/D branch closeout; before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not alter Fia/D quest outcomes for shopping convenience.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Purchase desired finite champion equipment / represented stock and reconcile remembrance redemption separately in the protected Phase 22D planner.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before NG+ Readiness; remembrance choices must follow 22D rather than merchant status.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not treat remembrance redemption as an ordinary shop purchase.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear all finite learned inventory after delivering the intended scroll/prayerbook expansions used by the completion route.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before NG+; no artificial early deadline.
merchantCloseout.notes: Miriel is a stable consolidation vendor; buy finite stock eventually.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite shop inventory before completing the quest state that removes direct access.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before final Thops quest handoff; otherwise use valid recovery if available.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not miss finite shop stock while advancing the quest.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite stock before the Ranni/Blaidd/Iji chain reaches its terminal state, or use valid bell-bearing continuity.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before final Ranni-side NPC closeout; before NG+.
merchantCloseout.notes: Preserve Journey 1 Ranni progression first.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Resolve every branch-limited puppet/shop acquisition according to BASE-002/003/004/005/011 before Seluvis becomes unavailable in that journey.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before advancing Ranni past the Seluvis cutoff in each assigned journey.
merchantCloseout.notes: This shop is branch-sensitive; use the canonical three-journey matrix, not an ad-hoc purchase order.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite inventory while preserving the Millicent branch assigned to the current journey.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before resolving BASE-007 in that journey; use legitimate recovery/bearing if applicable.
merchantCloseout.notes: Journey 1 must preserve the assist-Millicent cure route.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Obtain completion-relevant finite purchase(s) and unlock his intended consumable shop state without allowing the Dung Eater sequence to erase the opportunity first.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before the linked Dung Eater progression can terminate his direct shop access.
merchantCloseout.notes: Finite items matter; infinite consumables are availability-only and need not be bought out.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite inventory or recover it through the legitimate post-quest continuity path while preserving the BASE-005 puppet outcome assignment.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before / immediately after the Pidia terminal state associated with the current Nepheli branch.
merchantCloseout.notes: Coordinate merchant and puppet outcomes rather than treating them as independent systems.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite stock while preserving the DLC-001 Moore state assigned to the current journey and any Forager Brood completion obligations.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before the Moore branch reaches its terminal state in that journey; before DLC finale closeout.
merchantCloseout.notes: Journey 1 keeps the fullest continuation branch; later cycles cover alternates.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite shop inventory and secure the quest item access needed by the assigned DLC branches before his shop phase ends.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before the Thiollier/St. Trina quest advances beyond shop access and before the sealing-tree finale cutoff.
merchantCloseout.notes: Journey 2 Priestess-concoction branch depends on the established canonical plan.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Clear finite shop inventory before the Ymir/Jolán quest conclusion removes direct access; later reward branches follow DLC-006/007.
merchantCloseout.deadline: Before final Ymir/Jolán resolution and before DLC finale closeout.
merchantCloseout.notes: Do not collapse the Jolán/Anna three-journey collection plan into a merchant shortcut.

merchantCloseout.obligation: Before each journey transition, verify all finite/one-stock merchant obligations for that journey are purchased or deliberately assigned to a later canonical branch; Journey 1 must pass the external merchant/inventory audit before NG+.
merchantCloseout.deadline: CERT-J1-NG-002 / pre-NG+ readiness; repeat targeted closeout before later-cycle transitions.
merchantCloseout.authority: Journey Planner + Inventory Coverage Audit + Phase 22C firewall
merchantCloseout.notes: No merchant may remain “unknown”; each finite obligation must be Purchased, branch-deferred with an explicit journey, or proven externally non-required.
